objective: Consume the ordinary arbitrary-exterior lifting theorem content and its exact repository source/edge-ownership chain in S10, while failing closed on the absence of a repository-bound S11 theorem artifact.

atomic_claims.text: Under an exact common boundary after alias normalization, complete exterior-contact ownership, consistent shared boundary arcs, and for every valid complete Q colouring a same-boundary valid P lift with both-colour positive reachability inclusion R_P^+ subseteq R_Q^+, every valid colouring of Q union F lifts to P union F with F fixed.

The generic lifting content is repository-derived from C13 exact gluing, C31 one-sided profile replacement, C34 pinched-interface ownership, C37 saturated-star instantiation and C48 exact-parent precedence; S10 finite clean-room controls corroborate the row-level semantics.

On an exact common tournament interface with identical arc directions, ordinary valid same-boundary extension automatically preserves the complete positive boundary relation; this shortcut is not valid on a generic partial interface.

At the frozen base no repository-bound S11 theorem branch, pull request, candidate artifact, packet or Issue locator exists, so S11 artifact identity remains NOT_VERIFIABLE_MISSING_SOURCE even though the theorem content can be audited from older repository-bound sources.

assumptions: All digraphs are finite; a valid binary colouring makes both full induced colour classes acyclic.
Boundary reachability R+ uses positive-length monochromatic directed paths; empty paths are excluded and paths through other boundary vertices are included.
Boundary aliases are normalized before geometry, ownership and reachability are evaluated.
P and Q have the same actual exterior boundary B; every contact from patch interior to the exterior is source-accounted through B.
Shared boundary arcs have identical directions and are counted once in the union.
Class preservation, reverse-arc guards and strict order decrease are separately established before invoking minimum-order counterexample minimality.
risks: The theorem-content audit is not identity-equivalent to consuming a missing S11 producer artifact.
All repository candidates and this consumer remain candidate-level; no registered trusted verifier receipt is created.
C48's phrase same controlled region is insufficient as a standalone ownership contract unless the exact C13/C31/C34 contact conditions are inherited.
Changing the boundary by port release, alias change, complete-star absorption or separator crossing creates a new theorem instance and is not covered by stale ownership metadata.
No ordinary-to-anchored lane conversion, global source generation, unique L_join or root closure follows.
